title: The Electromagnetic Spectrum in Astronomy | Space Atlas
description: Visible light is a tiny sliver of what telescopes actually detect. Drag across the spectrum from radio to gamma rays and see what each band reveals in space.
ogDescription: Visible light is a tiny sliver of the spectrum — drag across radio, infrared, UV, X-ray, and gamma ray bands to see what each reveals.
jsonldDescription: An interactive tool for exploring the electromagnetic spectrum from radio to gamma rays, with real astronomical examples observed in each band.
